name: Eternal Wellspring
tagline: The Word of God became flesh - Your only Way to the Tree of Life
description: The Bible’s story is larger than most of us are aware of. Yahweh’s purpose has not changed since before creation: to dwell with His human family on the earth.The Cross opens the way. The story is not finished until God lives with His people — and those who overcome eat of the tree of life in the Paradise of God. Rev 2:7When you can see the whole of God's plan, verses that once passed you by begin to fall into place. You need not read every supporting scripture. The ones you do need, open so you can check a claim without leaving the thought. Familiar ground is covered quickly. Over unfamiliar ground, take your time in the Word.Choose a topic. Read the story. Drink the Word.
